faq.question: Q1. What is the Zilla Parishad Parbhani Ad-hoc Medical Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment notification issued by Zilla Parishad Parbhani to fill ad-hoc Medical Officer posts in primary health centers on a temporary contract basis.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 09 vacancies available for the ad-hoc Medical Officer posts.

faq.question: Q3. When is the walk-in interview for ZP Parbhani Medical Officer?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 08 October 2026 at 10:00 AM.

faq.question: Q4. Where will the walk-in interview be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at the District Collector Office, Parbhani.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.B.B.S. or B.A.M.S. degree.

faq.question: Q6. Can B.A.M.S. candidates apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Yes, but B.A.M.S. candidates will be considered only if M.B.B.S. candidates are not available.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary for the Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: M.B.B.S. qualified candidates receive Rs. 75,000/- per month, while B.A.M.S. qualified candidates receive Rs. 40,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q9. What documents need to be brought to the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring all years' mark sheets, degree certificates, experience certificates, birth date proof, registration certificate, internship completion certificate, and Aadhaar card along with one set of photocopies.
